compilationAcceptance.instruction: 格式、参数、引用错误需修正；设计后看本区和全城预览，可带 targetDistrictId、当前 baseDraftHash 和 assessment 重新提交该区完整 districtDesign。其他区设计与布局保留。qualityFullySatisfied、allFunctionAreasFormed、allRequiredContentPresent、structureGraphConnected 等均为诊断，不设清零门槛；其中指向功能未展开、组团不相接或缺少生活空间的提示，应修订或在 assessment 写明理由。整城通过逐区选材与阵列修订形成整体性，允许隔河，不要求接触或固定距离。挤占不得清空或破坏其他区功能主体。

designReview.instruction: Review actual core/support composition. Isolated cores must be repaired before FINAL; authored self-contained courts count as composition. Also judge visual scale and support quality; a numerical companion alone does not establish the intended effect. Use existing bounded failure handling and record rework counts.
